evals.expected_output: Analyzes Apple deal against CEP stages and outputs a stage recommendation

Compares activities against CEP stage definitions
Outputs a CEP Stage Analysis section with recommended stage

Lists missing activities with their expected stage

evals.expected_output: Analyzes Apple deal and identifies stage gaps

Evaluates exit criteria for each stage
Recommends the highest stage where all exit criteria are met
Flags if Salesforce stage is ahead of evidence
